task_title: Fix Floor 1 seed-39 boss-contact retreat regression

plan_review.plan_divergence: none - implementation matched the reviewed root-cause/fix plan exactly; reviewer flagged 3 non-blocking follow-up suggestions and 1 optional hardening suggestion, not a divergence
plan_review.notes: Verdict: approved_with_changes. Reviewer confirmed the fix is well-targeted (narrow distance-based carve-out on the existing ranged-shooter Retreat bail-out) and no different architecture is warranted. Addressed concern #1 (test proves symptom not exact predicate) by adding two focused unit tests in tests/game/behavior-tree-ai.test.ts pinning the exact attackRange+distance boundary (contact-range retreats; still-at-range defers to Engage), and confirmed the new predicate-pinning test fails against the pre-fix condition. Concerns #2 (CONTACT_SAFE_ORBIT_FT double-duty naming), #3 (mid-floor slime-rat boss may share the same shape), and #4 (potential boundary thrash near the threshold) are noted as follow-up hardening ideas outside this regressions minimal-fix scope; none block this narrowly-scoped bugfix.

findings.issue: maxWallTimeMs (300000ms) exceeded the Vitest test timeout (120000ms), so Vitest would kill the test with a generic timeout instead of the runner surfacing a controlled timeout message
findings.resolution: lowered maxWallTimeMs to 90000ms, safely below the 120000ms test timeout; re-ran test to confirm it still passes (28s actual runtime)
